SELECT p.project_code,
       p.project_name,
       SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)) AS net_budget,
       SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) AS used_budget,
       SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remain_budget,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)), 0), 2) AS burn_rate_pct
FROM transaction_statement ts
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = ts.project_id
WHERE ts.dept_code = '10130000'

SELECT p.project_code,
       p.project_name,
       t.net_budget,
       t.used_budget,
       t.remain_budget,
       ROUND(t.used_budget * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.net_budget, 0), 2) AS burn_rate_pct
FROM (
    SELECT project_id,
           SUM(CAST(net_budget AS REAL))    AS net_budget,
           SUM(CAST(used_budget AS REAL))   AS used_budget,
           SUM(CAST(remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remain_budget
    FROM transaction_statement
    WHERE dept_code = '10070000'
      AND fiscal_year = 2026
      AND month = 8
    GROUP BY project_id
) t
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id
WHERE t.remain_budget > 21750000
ORDER BY t.remain_budget DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT d.dept_code,
       COALESCE(SUM(CAST(t.net_budget AS REAL)), 0) AS net_budget,
       COALESCE(SUM(CAST(t.used_budget AS REAL)), 0) AS used_budget,
       COALESCE(SUM(CAST(t.remain_budget AS REAL)), 0) AS remain_budget,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CAST(t.net_budget AS REAL)), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(SUM(CAST(t.used_budget AS REAL)) * 100.0 / SUM(CAST(t.net_budget AS REAL)), 2)
       END AS burn_rate_pct
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN transaction_statement t
       ON t.dept_code = d.dept_code
      AND t.fiscal_year = 2026
      AND t.month = 2
WHERE d.dept_name IN ('Faculty / Division 8', 'Faculty / Division 10')
GROUP BY d.dept_code
ORDER BY d.dept_code

WITH last_month AS (
  SELECT MAX(month) AS m
  FROM transaction_statement
  WHERE dept_code = '10160000' AND fiscal_year = 2026
),
proj AS (
  SELECT ts.project_id,
         SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL))    AS net_budget,
         SUM(CAST(ts.used_budget AS REAL))   AS used_budget,
         SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) AS remain_budget
  FROM transaction_statement ts
  JOIN last_month lm ON ts.month = lm.m
  WHERE ts.dept_code = '10160000' AND ts.fiscal_year = 2026
  GROUP BY ts.project_id
)

             / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(ts.net_budget AS REAL)), 0), 2) AS burn_rate_pct
FROM transaction_statement ts
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = ts.project_id
WHERE ts.dept_code = '10180000'
  AND ts.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND ts.month BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name
HAVING SUM(CAST(ts.remain_budget AS REAL)) > 65250000
ORDER BY remain_budget DESC
LIMIT 10
